verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only vendor-built automations, not user-defined rules: annual reports are filed automatically as they come due, and Company Profile edits propagate across records. Per-user customizable reminders are an adjacent notification feature, not a user-defined event-to-action rule engine, and there are no documented webhooks or workflow triggers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
